name: GetResponse
description: GetResponse is an all-in-one marketing platform combining email marketing, automation, landing pages, webinars, and SMS so businesses can manage the full customer journey from a single tool.
best_for: Positioned for entrepreneurs, e-commerce stores, and enterprise brands that want AI-assisted tools covering every step of the customer journey, from lead capture to repeat revenue.
features: Email marketing with AI-optimized send times for promotional and lifecycle emails
Marketing automation workflows including welcome sequences and cart recovery
AI-assisted landing page creation for campaigns and lead capture
SMS marketing and web push notifications
Forms and popups for lead generation
AI tools for content tailoring, copywriting, and layout selection
